_comment: USD per million tokens, per model: {"<model>": {"input": n, "output": n, "cache_read": n, "cache_write": n}}. All four fields are required and must be >= 0. input excludes cache tokens, which are priced only by cache_read/cache_write. The Operator adds an entry for every model they configure (ATLAS_PRIMARY_MODEL, ATLAS_SECONDARY_MODEL, ATLAS_GUARDRAIL_MODEL, ATLAS_JUDGE_MODEL), copying the provider's current price list (DA-15). A model without an entry raises UnknownModelPricing; cost is never assumed to be zero. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Path is set by ATLAS_PRICING_FILE.
